temporal_state_chain.observed: Maria notices Cheryl looking stressed and overwhelmed by stacks of paperwork and planning for the new community outreach project. Maria offers help, and Cheryl gratefully accepts.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria did not yet have a specific belief that Cheryl was overwhelmed by this project; she may have assumed Cheryl was managing her responsibilities.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes — Maria learns that Cheryl is stressed, overwhelmed, and open to receiving help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Maria believes Cheryl needs and welcomes assistance with the project.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concern, empathy, and willingness to help.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To assist Cheryl with the paperwork and planning for the community outreach project.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After helping Cheryl, Maria sees Cheryl handling responsibilities better and growing in confidence. In a staff meeting, Maria suggests Cheryl lead the next phase, and Cheryl accepts.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria believes Cheryl has benefited from their collaboration and is becoming more capable, but she has not yet expressed a belief that Cheryl should take on leadership.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes — Maria's observations strengthen her confidence that Cheryl is ready for leadership, and Cheryl's acceptance confirms her willingness.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Maria believes Cheryl is ready and willing to lead the next phase of the project.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To support Cheryl in taking on the leadership role and to help the project succeed.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Maria worries her leadership suggestion may have felt like overstepping. She approaches Cheryl privately, and Cheryl says she was surprised but appreciates Maria's support and belief in her.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria believes Cheryl is ready and willing to lead, but she is concerned that her public suggestion might have pressured Cheryl or caused hard feelings.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes — Cheryl's response reassures Maria that she did not feel pressured and values Maria's support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Maria believes Cheryl appreciated her support and that there is no misunderstanding between them.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To ensure Cheryl feels supported and to maintain open, positive communication with her.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Following their private conversation, Maria proposes that she and Cheryl co-lead the project. Cheryl responds enthusiastically, saying Maria's guidance is invaluable and that they make a great team.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria feels relieved that Cheryl valued her honesty and support, and she believes their relationship is positive enough to explore closer collaboration.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes — Cheryl's enthusiastic response confirms that co-leading is mutually welcome and that Cheryl values Maria's guidance.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Maria believes she and Cheryl can successfully co-lead the project and support each other as a strong team.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To co-lead the project with Cheryl and continue supporting each other.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Maria and Cheryl have successfully collaborated on several projects, strengthening their partnership. Maria discusses future projects, and Cheryl says she would love to team up again and is excited about what they can achieve together.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria believes their collaboration has been fruitful and their partnership has strengthened through several successful projects.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes — Cheryl's response confirms that she shares Maria's enthusiasm for continuing their partnership on future projects.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Maria believes they have strong synergy and a mutual desire to keep working together on future projects.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To team up with Cheryl for more projects in the future.
